mechanismOfAction.summary: Senolytic D-retro-inverso peptide that disrupts FOXO4-p53 binding.
mechanismOfAction.description: FOXO4 DNA-binding-domain fragment synthesized as an all-D, reversed (D-retro-inverso) peptide fused to a TAT cell-penetrating sequence, conferring proteolytic resistance. Disrupts FOXO4-p53 interaction in senescent cells, causing p53 nuclear exclusion and selective apoptosis (senolysis). Renal-clearance concerns; mouse data only.
